orpheus-dan.text: We simulated tonight's Thunder and Nuggets game 10,000 times. Oklahoma City won 61% of them and, on average, it finished Thunder won 16, Nuggets won 11. The swing factor was Nikola Jockic. In the Sims where he posted a triple-double, Denver flipped the result more often than not. Here's how all 10,000 played out. It's the two-minute drill and you've got 10 seconds. Last Tuesday, the Knicks and the Celtics went down to the wire. Who scored more fourth-quarter points? Jalen Brunson or Jason Tatum? Time's up! It was Brunson with 14. Got it right? You're already ahead of half the comment section.
